en.title: Triplets with Sum Divisible by d
en.description: Given daily stock prices arr and a positive integer d, count the triplets (i,j,k) of distinct indices with i<j<k such that arr[i]+arr[j]+arr[k] is divisible by d.
en.input: The first line contains n and d, and the second line contains n integers arr. Ranges on this site: 0≤n≤2000, 1≤d≤1000, -2³¹≤arr[i]≤2³¹−1. The bounds n≤2000 and d≤1000 and the allowance for negative numbers were added by this site for the OJ; the original site did not give complete constraints.
en.output: Output the number of index triplets that satisfy the condition.
en.explanation: This problem follows OAMaster's explicit reference to LeetCode 2964 and counts distinct index combinations; triplets with equal values but different indices are still considered different.
hints: Only the remainder of each number modulo d matters. After enumerating an ordered combination of two remainders, the third remainder is uniquely determined; then use combination counts to handle repeated remainders.
